summary: VIGIA ESTELAR is a health monitoring software developed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It collects physical and behavioral health indicators, including heart rate, sleep, stress, anxiety, and fatigue. The system analyzes recorded information, identifies potential warning signs, and generates alerts with recommendations. It addresses the challenge by empowering astronauts to monitor their own health and take preventive action, improving their safety, well-being, and performance in space.
details: VIGIA ESTELAR is a health monitoring software designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It records and monitors physical and behavioral health indicators, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, body temperature, sleep, stress, anxiety, and fatigue. The system works through a web-based platform where astronauts enter their health information, which is stored in database and processed using json. PHP manages the application, evaluates predefined health conditions, and generates alerts with recommendations when unusual indicators are detected. Its main benefits include early identification of potential health problems, continuous self-monitoring, preventive care, and improved health awareness. We hope to help astronauts make informed decisions, manage stress, maintain healthy habits, and protect their physical and psychological well-being in isolated environments
